workflows.scenario: Start a simulator session, verify the dashboard is usable, and cover one safe read-only account activity journey. Do not create an account, submit personal information, transfer funds, pay bills, or perform external financial activity.
preconditions: User is on the NGPF bank simulator landing page

steps.action: Open the simulator landing page and click GET STARTED NOW
steps.expected: The bank simulator dashboard renders with a welcome modal
The dashboard displays account activity summary cards

steps.action: Click VIEW ACCOUNT on Checking Account Activity
steps.expected: The Account Activity page displays the checking account transactions table

steps.action: Switch account view to Saving account
steps.expected: The transaction table updates to display saving account activity

workflows.test: generated_tests/www.ngpf.org/playwright_tests/tests/account-activity.spec.ts#verify bank simulator dashboard and view checking account activity
